e.title: NGFS 气候情景（第 5 版，2024-11）：保险与监管气候压力测试的基准情景
e.title_en: NGFS climate scenarios (version 5, November 2024): the baseline scenarios behind insurance and supervisory climate stress testing
e.title_hk: NGFS 氣候情景（第 5 版，2024-11）：保險與監管氣候壓力測試的基準情景
e.summary: 央行与监管机构绿色金融网络的情景门户：第 5 版情景（2024-11）及 Data & Resources、IIASA 情景浏览器与 Climate Impact Explorer
e.summary_en: The central banks’ and supervisors’ Network for Greening the Financial System scenario portal: version 5 scenarios (November 2024) plus Data & Resources, the IIASA Scenario Explorer and the Climate Impact Explorer
e.summary_hk: 央行與監管機構綠色金融網絡的情景門戶：第 5 版情景（2024-11）及 Data & Resources、IIASA 情景瀏覽器與 Climate Impact Explorer
e.body:
**NGFS（央行与监管机构绿色金融网络）气候情景**是全球**气候压力测试的事实基准**——由各国央行与监管机构共同维护，**保险监管与保险公司的气候情景分析（含 ORSA 与气候披露）普遍以其为起点**。本条属本轮的**数据层缺口**取向：实测池内 **NGFS 相关条目为 0**，而池内气候侧已有大量**建模与巨灾工具**（[[climada]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[physrisk]]、[[openquake-engine]]、[[typhoon-cat-model]]、[[perils-ied]]）与**情景生成器**（[[economicscenariogenerators-jl]]、[[pyesg]]、[[esg-generator-python]]、[[hull-white-esg-checks]]）——**缺的正是「监管与行业共同认可的情景集」本身**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：NGFS 主站 122.2KB；**情景门户 `/ngfs-scenarios-portal/` 133.4KB**，导航实测含 **Introduction／Explore long-term scenarios／Use long-term scenarios／Data & Resources**；**Data & Resources 页 91.9KB**，其正文实测写明：**「The data and technical resources available here correspond to version 5 of the NGFS scenarios published in November 2024」**，并预告可查**第四批（2023）、第三批（2022）、第二批（2021）与第一批**的数据资源；页面实测链接到 **NGFS IIASA 情景浏览器**（`data.ene.iiasa.ac.at/ngfs/`）、**Climate Impact Explorer**（`climate-impact-explorer.climateanalytics.org`）以及第三方数据集（如 ANU CAMA 的 G-CUBED 建模结果、FINEXUS 的 CPRS 项目）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「情景集」这一层**——气候风险在保险里最终要落到**「用哪套情景、怎么映射到资产与负债」**；池内工具体系（巨灾模型、情景生成器、偿付能力计算 [[solvency2rfr]]、[[ggsolvencyii]]、[[sii-equity-risk-scr]]、[[eiopa-monthly-rfr-check]]）**都需要一个公认的情景基准**，NGFS 正是那个基准，且**其版本号（本次实测为第 5 版，2024-11）在论文中必须写明**。**② 结构上可与监管口径对接**——监管气候压力测试（如 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]] 所属监管体系、[[iais-icp]] 一类国际框架、[[iais-gimar]] 的全球市场报告）常引用 NGFS 情景，故它同时是**「监管 → 情景 → 保险公司内部模型」**链条的中间环节；**③ 与 ESG/可持续条目并读**——[[esg]]、[[awesome-sustainable-finance]]、[[insurance-scr-data]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**门户结构、Data & Resources 页正文（含第 5 版与 2024-11 的时间信息）与若干资源链接**，**但未下载任何情景数据集**；**② IIASA 情景浏览器页实测仅 1,847 字节（前端应用外壳，含登录跳转）**，**故词条不描述其取数步骤**；**③** 第三方数据集（CAMA G-CUBED、FINEXUS CPRS）**归属与许可未核实**；**④** NGFS 情景**按批次更新**（本次为第 5 版），**历史批次与最新批次口径可能不同**，引用须写明**版本与下载日期**。**核实说明**：主站（122.2KB）、情景门户（133.4KB）、Data & Resources（91.9KB）、IIASA 入口（1.8KB）均 HTTP 200 实测；**未下载任何情景数据**。
e.body_en:
**The NGFS (Network for Greening the Financial System) climate scenarios** are the de facto **baseline for climate stress testing** worldwide — maintained by central banks and supervisors, they are **the usual starting point for insurers’ and supervisors’ climate scenario analysis, including ORSA and climate disclosure**. This entry follows the current **data-layer gap** approach: a measured search found **zero NGFS-related entries**, while the corpus’s climate side already holds substantial **modelling and catastrophe tooling** ([[climada]], [[climate-conditioned-cat]], [[physrisk]], [[openquake-engine]], [[typhoon-cat-model]], [[perils-ied]]) and **scenario generators** ([[economicscenariogenerators-jl]], [[pyesg]], [[esg-generator-python]], [[hull-white-esg-checks]]) — **what was missing is the commonly accepted scenario set itself**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the NGFS main site is 122.2KB; the **scenarios portal `/ngfs-scenarios-portal/`** is 133.4KB and its navigation shows **Introduction / Explore long-term scenarios / Use long-term scenarios / Data & Resources**; the **Data & Resources page** is 91.9KB and its text states verbatim: **"The data and technical resources available here correspond to version 5 of the NGFS scenarios published in November 2024"**, while pointing to the fourth batch (2023), third (2022), second (2021) and first batches. The page links to the **NGFS IIASA Scenario Explorer** (`data.ene.iiasa.ac.at/ngfs/`), the **Climate Impact Explorer** (`climate-impact-explorer.climateanalytics.org`) and third-party datasets (such as ANU CAMA’s G-CUBED modelling results and the FINEXUS CPRS project).

For RIAA: **① it adds the "scenario set" layer** — climate risk in insurance ultimately comes down to **which scenarios are used and how they map onto assets and liabilities**; the corpus’s tooling (catastrophe models, scenario generators, solvency calculations in [[solvency2rfr]], [[ggsolvencyii]], [[sii-equity-risk-scr]], [[eiopa-monthly-rfr-check]]) **all need an agreed scenario baseline**, and NGFS is that baseline — whose **version number (measured here as version 5, November 2024) must be stated in any citation**. **② It connects to the supervisory chain** — supervisory climate stress tests (the regime behind [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], international frameworks such as [[iais-icp]], and global market reporting such as [[iais-gimar]]) commonly cite NGFS scenarios, so it is also **the middle link in "supervisor → scenario → insurer internal model"**. **③** Read with the sustainability entries [[esg]], [[awesome-sustainable-finance]] and [[insurance-scr-data]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the portal structure, the Data & Resources body text (including version 5 and the November 2024 date) and several resource links**, **but downloaded no scenario dataset**; **② the IIASA Scenario Explorer page measured only 1,847 bytes (a front-end shell with a login redirect)**, so **no extraction steps are described**; **③** the third-party datasets (CAMA G-CUBED, FINEXUS CPRS) **were not verified for ownership or licensing**; **④** NGFS scenarios **are released in batches** (version 5 here) and **earlier and latest batches may differ in definition**, so citations must state **version and download date**. **Verification note**: the main site (122.2KB), scenarios portal (133.4KB), Data & Resources (91.9KB) and the IIASA entry (1.8KB) were all measured at HTTP 200; **no scenario data was downloaded**.
e.body_hk:
**NGFS（央行與監管機構綠色金融網絡）氣候情景**是全球**氣候壓力測試的事實基準**，**保險監管與保險公司的氣候情景分析普遍以其為起點**。本條屬**數據層缺口**取向：實測池內 **NGFS 相關條目為 0**，而池內氣候側已有大量**建模與巨災工具**（[[climada]]、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[physrisk]]、[[openquake-engine]]、[[typhoon-cat-model]]、[[perils-ied]]）與**情景生成器**（[[economicscenariogenerators-jl]]、[[pyesg]]、[[esg-generator-python]]、[[hull-white-esg-checks]]）——**缺的正是「監管與行業共同認可的情景集」本身**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：主站 122.2KB；**情景門戶 133.4KB**，導航含 **Introduction／Explore／Use／Data & Resources**；**Data & Resources 頁 91.9KB**，正文實測寫明 **「…correspond to version 5 of the NGFS scenarios published in November 2024」**，並指向第四批（2023）、第三（2022）、第二（2021）與第一批；頁面實測鏈接 **NGFS IIASA 情景瀏覽器**與 **Climate Impact Explorer**，以及第三方數據集。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「情景集」這一層**——氣候風險最終要落到**「用哪套情景、如何映射到資產與負債」**；池內工具（巨災模型、情景生成器、償付能力計算 [[solvency2rfr]]、[[ggsolvencyii]]、[[sii-equity-risk-scr]]）**都需要公認的情景基準**，NGFS 正是該基準，**其版本號（本次實測第 5 版，2024-11）在論文中必須寫明**；**②** 監管氣候壓力測試常引用 NGFS 情景，故它同時是**「監管 → 情景 → 保險公司內部模型」**的中間環節；**③** 可與 [[esg]]、[[awesome-sustainable-finance]]、[[insurance-scr-data]] 並讀。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**門戶結構、Data & Resources 正文與資源鏈接**，**但未下載任何情景數據集**；**② IIASA 情景瀏覽器頁實測僅 1,847 字節（前端外殼，含登入跳轉）**，**故不描述取數步驟**；**③** 第三方數據集**歸屬與許可未核實**；**④** NGFS 情景**按批次更新**，引用須寫明**版本與下載日期**。**核實說明**：四項均 HTTP 200 實測；**未下載任何情景數據**。
e.verified_note: HTTP 200 实测（NGFS 主站 122.2KB；情景门户 /ngfs-scenarios-portal/ 133.4KB；Data & Resources 91.9KB；IIASA 入口 data.ene.iiasa.ac.at/ngfs/ 1,847B 前端外壳）+ 正文实测含「version 5 of the NGFS scenarios published in November 2024」与第四/三/二/一批次说明 + 实测链接 Climate Impact Explorer、ANU CAMA G-CUBED、FINEXUS CPRS；未下载任何情景数据集
